name: hdie_host_phy_r1

pin_regs.reason: RTL registers every pin: every input lands in an unconditional pin flop (data) or a reset pin flop (valid/strobe/status), every output is a flop Q (HBMA-HOST 2026-10-17 audit of the source); a kit flop stage would add a redundant edge

job.purpose: host_phy r2 (HBM-NATIVE 10-17): feedthrough pin flops split into an input-pin capture flop + an output-pin launch flop on TX/RX/session (+1 edge each, elastic link); native audit phy_tx launch 255.2 > 220

reroute_reason.why: routed native pin audit (NATIVE-BATCH 10-17): phy_tx launch up to 255.2 > 220 ps on 12 pins: phy_tx <= ep_tx was ONE feedthrough flop between the S (ep_tx) and N (phy_tx) faces, so it sat at its ep_tx pin (phy_tx[460] flop at y 3.2, 87+45 um from its N pin); TX, RX and session are now capture flop at the input pin + launch flop at the output pin (+1 edge each, elastic link)

job.structural_change: host_phy r2 (HBM-NATIVE 10-17): every face-to-face feedthrough (ep_tx S -> phy_tx N, phy_rx W -> ep_rx E, session_pad S -> session E) is two flops, capture at the input pin and launch at the output pin (io_flop_at_pins anchors each at its own face); +1 edge TX/RX/session vs r1, elastic host link (endpoint CRC/replay/credits) so no compile-schedule change; pad/status checks unchanged. Lockstep tb_host_phy_pin_stage vs the closed dcfed59ab RTL (data +1 edge, faults same edge), mutant rejected.

slot_change_request: HBMA-HOST 10-17 -> H-DIE: d4f slot 41.04x41.04 is pin-bound (2052 pins, 20.8/um); needs 90.72x90.72 (4 faces of ~515 pins at <=5.7/um; host_N UCIe is N/W, endpoint E/S)
